verdict.rationale: Stripe Agentic Commerce is a commerce/payments platform for sellers and agent builders, not an AI agent or orchestration framework — its role is to expose its own capabilities as an MCP server/tool provider (docs.stripe.com/mcp) for other agents to consume, not to itself act as an MCP client plugging in third-party MCP servers. No evidence describes Stripe Agentic Commerce consuming external MCP servers' tools, and this capability is outside its product category.
